findings.summary: Candidate-004 exposes Direct and Block as valid default targets while its deny scope freezes SingBoxCompiler unchanged; the current compiler accepts only Pool as final outbound, so either value saves successfully but every Apply deterministically fails configurationFailed.
Pre-worker Apply failures lacked generation- and operation-bound authoritative terminal memory.
The shared Provider lacked event invalidation, continuing Apply convergence and stale-response ordering.
Dialog Escape handlers captured stale non-busy state and could discard input during a pending mutation.
The mutation command synchronously waited on Apply or selector runtime work.

The frozen acceptance and evidence matrix was incomplete; unit coverage was expanded, but final current-source native, real selector fixture, restart, visual parity and independent rereview remain pending.
